title: A Recipe for the Tryouts
author: Coral Whitlock
blurb: Ansel Almeida, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before prom.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
